## Model Details

This model is an int4 (W4A16, group_size 32, symmetric) model of [google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it](https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it) generated by [intel/auto-round](https://github.com/intel/auto-round) with 200 tuning iterations. Please follow the license of the original model.

- **Quantized (W4A16)**: routed experts, shared MLP, attention
- **Kept in BF16**: router, embeddings, vision tower, norms

## How to Use

### Environment

```bash
uv pip install vllm==0.32.0
```

### vLLM Usage

```bash
vllm serve INCModel4/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-W4A16-AutoRound \
    --attention-backend FLASHINFER \
    --language-model-only \
    --dtype bfloat16
```

## Evaluation

| Benchmark | BF16 | W4A16 | Recovery |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| PIQA | 72.58 | 73.67 | 101.50% |
| HellaSwag | 47.34 | 48.77 | 103.01% |
| MMLU | 46.44 | 48.08 | 103.53% |
| GSM8K | 95.30 | 94.69 | 99.36% |
| **Average** | **65.41** | **66.30** | **101.35%** |

```bash
lm_eval --model vllm \
    --model_args pretrained=INCModel4/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-W4A16-AutoRound,tensor_parallel_size=2,max_model_len=131072,gpu_memory_utilization=0.9,dtype=bfloat16,trust_remote_code=True,add_bos_token=True,enable_prefix_caching=False,max_gen_toks=2048,attention_backend=FLASHINFER,language_model_only=True,kv_cache_dtype=auto,max_num_seqs=64,max_num_batched_tokens=32768,enable_thinking=False,enable_flashinfer_autotune=False \
    --tasks piqa,mmlu,hellaswag \
    --batch_size 64 \
    --apply_chat_template \
    --fewshot_as_multiturn \
    --seed 42

lm_eval --model vllm \
    --model_args pretrained=INCModel4/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-W4A16-AutoRound,tensor_parallel_size=2,max_model_len=131072,gpu_memory_utilization=0.9,dtype=bfloat16,trust_remote_code=True,add_bos_token=True,enable_prefix_caching=False,max_gen_toks=2048,attention_backend=FLASHINFER,language_model_only=True,kv_cache_dtype=auto,max_num_seqs=64,max_num_batched_tokens=32768,enable_thinking=False,enable_flashinfer_autotune=False \
    --tasks gsm8k \
    --batch_size 64 \
    --num_fewshot 5 \
    --apply_chat_template \
    --fewshot_as_multiturn \
    --seed 42
```

## Generate the Model

```bash
auto-round \
    --model_name google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it \
    --scheme W4A16 \
    --iters 200 \
    --nsamples 128 \
    --group_size 32 \
    --ignore_layers vision_tower,router \
    --format auto_round \
    --disable_torch_compile \
    --output_dir gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-W4A16-AutoRound
```

## Ethical Considerations and Limitations

The model can produce factually incorrect output, and should not be relied on to produce factually accurate information. Because of the limitations of the pretrained model and the finetuning datasets, it is possible that this model could generate lewd, biased or otherwise offensive outputs.
Therefore, before deploying any applications of the model, developers should perform safety testing.
